text:
alex_k: Heads-up — Acme (T-6142) reporting p95 spikes (~4x) and intermittent 429s from their eu dedicated pool. Correlated to node eu2-dedicated-7. Suspect noisy neighbor / MIG slice interference. Spike started ~08:15 UTC. Anyone oncall?
maria_oncall: On it. Can you paste sample request IDs / logs and the model + slice config?
alex_k: sample logs:
```
req_id=acme-abc123 p95=1200ms status=200 model=redwood-xl-13b slice=mig-2g.5gb node=eu2-dedicated-7 sm_util=98% kv_cache_hit=0.12
req_id=acme-def456 p95=2100ms status=429 model=redwood-xl-13b slice=mig-2g.5gb node=eu2-dedicated-7 sm_util=99% kv_cache_hit=0.05
```
infra-bot: Autoscaler event: scale 1->3 triggered 08:16UTC for pool eu2-dedicated, but scale limited by reserved_commit quota (policy=commit-limit). Recommend temporary burst policy if we want faster relief.
josh_eng: Looking at node telemetry — neighbor tenant shows high short SM bursts + periodic PCIe memcpy spikes. MIG partitions appear correct, but L3 cache thrashing across slices is visible (per-slice L3 evictions surge). Could be cohost kernel patterns causing contention.
tara_support: Acme also reported auth 429s around same time — likely retries piling after backend token throttling. I'll prepare a quick isolation move (queueing to move tenant to isolated slice) as a mitigation.
maria_oncall: Before we migrate, let's try a repro to be sure: run a synthetic with same sequence length/concurrency on eu2-dedicated-7: 
```
wrk -t4 -c20 -d60s http://eu2-proxy/generate -H 'x-tenant:acme' -p './prompt.json'
```
alex_k: Additional note: KV cache hit rate dropped from 0.82 -> 0.11 during the spike window (08:14–08:18). Suggests eviction pressure from co-located workloads.
josh_eng: Proposed plan:
1) Move Acme to eu2-isolated-slice-2 (start now)
2) Apply temporary kernel-gating to reduce noisy neighbor SM priority
3) Add L3-thrash detection rule to the autoscaler/eviction pipeline long-term
I'll open infra PR for (2)/(3).
tara_support: Migration kicked at 08:23 UTC -> acme moved to eu2-isolated-slice-2. Early metrics: p95 dropped to ~220ms, 429s stopped. Please verify with customer. :thumbsup:
alex_k: Confirmed with Acme SRE — latency stable, no more 429s, billing unchanged. Closing T-6142. Root cause summary: co-host L3 thrash + autoscale limited by commit quota delaying relief. Follow-ups: update autoscale burst policy and implement L3-thrash detection alert.
maria_oncall: Thanks everyone — I'll file follow-up tasks in Jira and add a runbook entry for "dedicated: noisy neighbor L3 thrash -> migrate to isolated slice + check commit limits". :white_check_mark:
